# ☀️ SunStride Smart Station — Local ESP8266 Dashboard

**ATL Engineering Prototype** > _A self-contained, local-first IoT public transit interface & hybrid renewable energy monitoring system powered by ESP8266._

## 📌 Project Overview

**SunStride Smart Station** is an innovative public transportation prototype designed to solve two major urban transit challenges:

1. **Intelligent Bus Tracking & Station Identification**: Providing real-time bus arrivals and platform guidance locally without requiring external cellular or cloud infrastructure.
2. **Sustainable Off-Grid Power Harvesting**: Generating clean electricity for station electronics and displays using a hybrid **Solar Array + Piezoelectric Footstep System**.

When passengers connect to the station's local Wi-Fi Access Point (SunStride_Station) and open <http://192.168.4.1>, they are greeted by this lightweight, high-performance operational dashboard hosted directly on the ESP8266 node.

## ✨ Key Features & Capabilities

### 🚌 1. Live Bus Tracking & Fleet Display

- **Catchy Fleet Identity**: Displays transit vehicles by name and code (e.g., _Solaris Express (SX-01)_, _EcoPulse Liner (EP-02)_, _VoltRunner (VR-03)_).
- **Status Indicators**: Instant visual distinction between **At Station** (🟢), **Approaching** (🔵), and **Not Detected** (⚪).
- **Timestamp Tracking**: Logs the last detected timestamp for every vehicle on the network.

### 🗺️ 2. "Where Is My Bus" Interactive Transit Overlay

- **Full-Screen Route Tracker**: Clicking on any bus row opens a transit overlay inspired by mobile train tracking apps.
- **Route Timeline**: Displays past stops (Departed), current station (Boarding Here), and upcoming destinations with live ETAs and assigned platform bays.
- **Live Occupancy Monitoring**: Visualizes passenger load capacity (_Low_, _Medium_, _High_).

### 📡 3. Real-Time RFID Sensor Panel

- **MFRC522 Scanner Sync**: Simulates/displays physical RFID tag scans (E200 4106 9309 0124) when a bus enters the station's inductive detection zone.
- **Visual Detection Pulse**: Triggers an active scanning line animation and high-priority badge update upon event detection.

### ⚡ 4. Hybrid Renewable Energy Monitor

- **Solar Generation**: Monitors real-time solar panel output in Watts (![](data:image/png;base64,)).
- **Piezoelectric Harvesting**: Tracks dynamic kinetic energy generated by passenger footsteps across floor tiles.
- **Proportional Power Bar**: Dynamically visualizes the ratio between solar vs. piezo energy production.
- **Battery & Voltage Metrics**: Displays battery state of charge (%), system voltage (![](data:image/png;base64,)), and daily accumulated energy (![](data:image/png;base64,)).

### ⚡ 5. Offline & Local-First Architecture

- **Zero External Dependencies**: Built entirely with inline SVG vector icons, native CSS variables, and vanilla JS. Requires no internet connection or third-party CDN libraries.

| ---                           | ---                                                                         |

| ---                           | ---                                                                         |

## 💻 Software Architecture & File Structure

The application is structured as a consolidated, lightweight single-file artifact (index.html) optimized for storage within the ESP8266 flash memory (LittleFS or SPIFFS).
```
SunStride-Smart-Station/  
├── index.html # Main UI, CSS Design Tokens, and State Machine  
└── README.md # Project documentation & integration guide
```
### Technical Design Tokens

- **Base Background**: #0c1017
- **Surface Elevation**: #141b26
- **Accent Green (Status/Solar)**: #00e699
- **Accent Blue (Approaching/Piezo)**: #00b0ff
- **Accent Amber (Solar High)**: #ffab00
- **Typography**: -apple-system, SF Mono, Roboto Mono

## 🔌 ESP8266 Integration & API Data Contract

The dashboard JavaScript is designed around a centralized stationState object. To bind this interface to real hardware sensors on the ESP8266, simply replace the mock telemetry loop with WebSocket or REST polling events.

### Arduino / ESP8266 C++ Server Example (ESPAsyncWebServer)
```
# include &lt;ESP8266WiFi.h&gt;

# include &lt;ESPAsyncWebServer.h&gt;

# include &lt;LittleFS.h&gt;
```
```
<br/>AsyncWebServer server(80);  
<br/>void setup() {  
Serial.begin(115200);  
LittleFS.begin();  
<br/>// Configure SoftAP Mode  
WiFi.softAP("SunStride_Station", "");  
Serial.print("Station Dashboard available at: ");  
Serial.println(WiFi.softAPIP());  
<br/>// Serve static HTML file from LittleFS  
server.on("/", HTTP_GET, \[\](AsyncWebServerRequest \*request){  
request->send(LittleFS, "/index.html", "text/html");  
});  
<br/>// Telemetry API Endpoint  
server.on("/api/telemetry", HTTP_GET, \[\](AsyncWebServerRequest \*request){  
String json = getStationTelemetryJson(); // Returns JSON matching schema above  
request->send(200, "application/json", json);  
});  
<br/>server.begin();  
}  
<br/>void loop() {  
// Read MFRC522 RFID and Energy Sensors here...  
}
```
## 🚀 Deployment Steps (ESP8266 LittleFS)

1. **Install LittleFS Plugin** for Arduino IDE or PlatformIO.
2. Create a data folder inside your Arduino sketch directory and place index.html inside it.
3. Upload index.html using **ESP8266 LittleFS Data Upload**.
4. Flash the ESP8266 firmware code.
5. Connect your mobile phone or laptop to the Wi-Fi network **SunStride_Station**.
6. Open your browser and navigate to <http://192.168.4.1>.
